name: Kamp
tagline: Vibration meter and seismograph for washing machines, fans, engines and floors.
description: Kamp turns your phone into a vibration meter. Rest it on a washing machine, fan, car engine, floor or bridge and watch a live seismograph of the shaking, with the current, peak and RMS acceleration, the dominant frequency and a simple intensity label from calm to severe. Record a session, save it, open the trace later and share it as CSV. Everything runs on your phone, with no ads and no tracking.
